name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and place the inside of your top leg or ankle on a bench, with your bottom leg hanging underneath.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line, supported by the top leg on the bench. The top leg's adductors do most of the work.
Hold the position, keeping your hips level and your core braced.
Lower and switch sides. Shorten the lever by putting your knee on the bench to make it easier.
image_prompt_scene: In a side plank on one forearm with the top leg resting on a bench.
